spans.s: Aila^1 = Purūravas. § 141 (Purūravas): I, 75, 3149.--§ 155 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 94, 3753 (Ailavaṃśavivardhanāḥ).--§ 267 (Yamasabhāv.): II, 8, 327 (in the palace of Yama).-§ 273 (Rājasūy.): II, 14, 568--9 (Ailavaṃśyāḥ).--§ 305 (Anudyūtap.): II, 78, 2576 (Purūravasam Ailaṃ).-§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 315.--§ 641 (Rājadh.): XII, 72, 2750 (Purūravasa Ailasya saṃvādaṃ Mātariśvanaḥ), (2757); 73, 2780 (Aila-Kaśyapa-saṃvādam), (†2781), †2791, (†2792), (†2794), (†2796), (†2798).--§ 673b (BaliVāsava-s.): XII, 227, 8261.--§ 723 (Ānuśāsanik): XIII, 6, 325 (attained to Heaven through the intercession of the brahmans).--§ 764 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 115, 5667 (among the kings that did not eat flesh during the month of Kārttika, and as a consequence thereof attained to Brahmaloka).-§ 770 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 151, 7127 (among the kings whose names one should name for success; Budhasya putraṃ). --§ 775 (do.): XIII, 166, 7678 (among the kings whose names should be recited at sunset and sunrise), 7683.
Ailavaṃśa (“the race descending from Ilā”). § 155 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 94, 3753 (ºvivardhanāḥ).

Ailavila^1 = Kubera. § 564 (Mātalīyop.): V, 102, 3611.-§ 565 (Gālavac.): V, 111, 3840 (dwells on Kailāsa).--§ 569 (Bhagavadyānap.): V, 139, 4717.--§ 615 (Baladevat.): IX, 47, 2753 (practising austerities in Kaubera-tīrtha, he obtained the lordship of all treasures--dhanādhipatyaṃ--and all kinds of wealth, etc., came to him of their own accord).
Ailavila^3 = an ancient king. § 656 (Khaḍgotp.): XII, 166, 6195 (received the Sword from Bharata and gave it to Dhundhumāra).
